modes.cue_notes: From a wide lunge, tip the torso over the bent front leg, forearm resting on the thigh or fingertips to the floor, top arm reaching long over the ear to create one clean line from back heel to fingertips.

breathing_cues.entering: Exhale to tip the torso over the front thigh, lengthening the top arm past the ear.
breathing_cues.holding: Inhale to extend the reaching arm and side body, exhale to root the front foot and deepen the bend.
breathing_cues.exiting: Inhale to press through the feet and rise the torso back upright over the hips.

prop_free_variation: Rest the forearm on the thigh instead of reaching the hand to the floor to keep the torso lengthened rather than collapsed.
